message.content:
🎉 Happy 40th Birthday, Walid! 🎉

Our wonderful friend and neighbor Walid is turning the big 4-0, and we're throwing him a party! 🥳

📅 **When:** This Saturday, 2 PM
📍 **Where:** The Park Pavilion
👋 **Who:** Everyone! All are welcome

Come celebrate with fun, food, great company and plenty of laughs. Rumor has it there may even be some karaoke. 🎤 Bring your best singing voice (or your worst, Walid won't mind!) and help us make this milestone one to remember.

Let's show Walid how much this community loves him! 🎂🎈

Here's to 40 fabulous years and many more! 🥂
